items.text: Having access to affordable health insurance has never been more important. That's why I voted for the #AmericanRescuePlan to lower costs and make coverage affordable for more folks. Today is the last day to enroll—go to https://t.co/R32yBKTDQ1 to find a plan that works for you.

Expanding Medicaid would immediately give more than a million Texans health care coverage and by continuing to refuse to do so, Texas is leaving billions of federal investments on the table. Expanding Medicaid is too good a deal for Texas to pass up. 
https://t.co/pfWkFSfAZX

Ted Cruz celebrated blocking the expansion of VA health coverage to 3.5 million post-9/11 combat veterans who were exposed to toxins while serving with a fist bump.

Our veterans have sacrificed and have earned these benefits. They deserve better. https://t.co/YYg9xdgLmM

The 1.8 million Texans who got covered because the #AmericanRescuePlan lowered premiums will see their insurance plans stay affordable thanks to the #InflationReductionAct. And folks on Medicare will pay no more than $35 a month for their insulin.

Today in Texas performing a medical procedure can get you life in prison. The GOP's trigger law puts women in danger and interferes with doctors' ability to provide the best care to their patients. It's disgusting and I'll never stop fighting to protect the right to choose.

In Texas, we've seen what happens when you criminalize abortion.

Women can't make decisions about their own bodies. 

Hospitals can't treat patients who need care.

If Republicans win majorities, they'll ban abortion nationwide, which will be devastating.
https://t.co/XFrsuyUMiA

Texas's extreme abortion law is denying women the life-saving care they need. I'm inspired by the women who are sharing their stories and speaking out against how harmful this law is for Texas women—but they shouldn't have to, the Texas GOP failed them. https://t.co/WeyI0GxsoM

Every Texan should have access to health care close to home. Texas is leaving billions of our tax dollars on the table because TX GOP leaders refuse to expand Medicaid. It's past time to put politics aside and do what's best for Texans and our economy.
https://t.co/AmRhFrSGz4

In Texas, pregnant women should be able to get the health care they need, yet Texas has some of the worst outcomes, especially for Black women.

This is unacceptable and we must do better.  

The state must expand post-partum coverage in Medicaid. https://t.co/VJkFL54SQs

Last year we took action to extend financial help and make health plans on https://t.co/R32yBKTDQ1 more affordable for middle class families.

Today is the last day to sign up for 2023 coverage, so #getcovered today!

Texas is on a shrinking list of states dug in on refusing to expand Medicaid. We're leaving $5.4 billion a year on the table and millions of Texans without the coverage they need. It makes too much sense to not expand Medicaid. Let's get it done.
https://t.co/mPzgx4Vcpc

The Affordable Care Act and protections for preventative care have benefited millions in Texas. Now special interests want to take away these protections in the courts. This is unacceptable, and I'll always fight back against attacks on your health care. https://t.co/KlcSZjJCt1

Everyone should have access to quality health care close to home. But in the last decade, 20 rural Texas hospitals have closed and 26% of those open still risk closure if we don’t act.

Rural Texans are suffering and Ted Cruz refuses to take action. https://t.co/y5ZOqvdTzv

I’m proud to have voted for the bipartisan bill in Congress that provides additional funding to rural hospitals.

Texas must expand Medicaid now - and I’m the only candidate running for Senate who supports that.

58 years ago, LBJ signed Medicare & Medicaid into law. Since then, millions of Texans & Americans have depended on these programs for reliable health care coverage and lifesaving prescriptions.
I’ll never stop fighting to protect these programs and make health care more accessible & affordable.

In the state with one of the highest uninsured rates in the nation, we should be working to get folks the health care they need, not taking away their coverage.

That’s why I will keep working to expand Medicaid and lower costs. https://t.co/aspjMIoqyZ

Texans deserve a Senator who works for them. Yet just last week, Ted Cruz was one of 7 Senators who voted against funding our government – including funding to keep Texas VA hospitals open.

Ted Cruz’s cynical partisan politics may be good fodder for his podcast – but they hurt veterans and working families in Texas.
https://t.co/YeQ22BA2jA

Texas has one of the highest uninsured rates in the country and since pandemic protections were lifted, nearly a million more Texans have lost their Medicaid coverage. Our state must expand Medicaid and get Texans the care they need.
https://t.co/VHC7Pf2ktf

On my first day in Congress, I led efforts to protect the ACA because I believe every Texan should have access to quality health care they can afford. While Ted Cruz would rather strip hardworking families of the coverage they need, I’ll always work to protect Texans’ care.

Texas has the highest uninsured rate in the country. It's unthinkable to talk about taking coverage away.

We must protect the ACA and expand access to health care. If Ted Cruz is re-elected, he’ll try to eliminate the ACA. We have to beat him in 2024.
https://t.co/8feaDkqZ8u

Our state has the highest uninsured rate in the nation. We should be making sure Texans have health care coverage, not kicking them off.

Our state must expand Medicaid and get Texans the care they need.
https://t.co/DyeUUuq5qd

It’s incomprehensible that judges, lawyers and politicians are telling doctors they cannot save their patients’ lives. Banning hospitals from providing women with life-saving emergency care is cruel and it is not who we are as Texans. 

We must codify Roe. https://t.co/TWp0mpxucJ

A sad day for sports journalism. As it was for so many, Sports Illustrated was important to me and defined sports coverage through several generations. Thanks to all the writers, editors, and photojournalists who made this legendary magazine what it was. https://t.co/Xc9AZB5bvf

Every Texan should have access to quality, affordable health care. That's why I worked to strengthen the Affordable Care Act and lower the cost of premiums. 

I'm glad that our efforts led to record sign-ups in Texas. In the Senate, I will protect the ACA.
https://t.co/5INnB5n4yI

Every Texan should have access to quality, affordable health care. That’s what I’ve been fighting for since my first day in Congress.

Given the chance, Ted Cruz would repeal the ACA. If I’m given the chance to serve as your Senator, I'll expand coverage and lower your costs. https://t.co/toTtHS0wSs
